notes.title: Official Publisher Announcement
notes.content:
[p]We are excited to announce that Pluto will be published by indie.io! These guys have helped publish [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio"]tons of indie games[/url] like ours and we feel lucky to have found a publisher that has been totally supportive of our vision.

The Open Playtest will be taken down this week as we head into the final stages of development, thanks again to everyone who participated. We'll be posting an updated demo soon, which will be shorter and better tuned. Follow our socials for updates, join the Discord to commune with fellow wizards, and make sure to wishlist Pluto on Steam!

For those of you who may not know, working with a game publishing platform like indie.io greatly helps indie developers focus on game development while they handle all the behind-the-scenes magic. From helping manage store pages to crafting marketing campaigns and even helping the game shine at both digital and live events, indie.io helps in all the aspects that indie developers often struggle with alone.[/p]

notes.title: Small patch
notes.content:
Small patch:
-Bug fixes
-Rendering options for windows users
-Expanded logging for catching some errors
-Hotkey "C" now clears your sequence and during reward choices, allows you to "C" your spells :)

Thanks!
